Name: Maaseiah, Son of Ahaz
Summary: Maaseiah, the king's son, was slain by Zichri, a mighty man of Ephraim, in Pekah's invasion of Judah.
KeyStory: Zichri slew Maaseiah the king's son, and Azrikam the governor of the house, and Elkanah next to the king.
RelatedPeople: Ahaz, King of Judah; Zichri, Man of Ephraim
LifeLesson: A king's idolatry cost even his own son's life.
